verdict.rationale: mise documents a configurable minimum release age (`minimum_release_age = "7d"`, with a 24-hour default for every backend aimed explicitly at malicious new releases). It also ships related protections: automatic Cosign/Minisign/SLSA/attestation verification for aqua tools and MISE_SAFE=1 to stop project config from executing code. The evidence does not show blocking of package lifecycle/install scripts. MISE_SAFE governs repository config, not package install scripts, so the second named protection is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented blocking of package lifecycle/install scripts, independent or hands-on corroboration of release-age enforcement.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can turn on protections against malicious packages, such as blocking lifecycle scripts or enforcing a minimum release age

citations.quote: minimum_release_age = "7d"  # only install versions released more than 7 days ago
